rules.name: Keep unattended work fail-closed
rules.statement: Durable schedules, candidate lineage, verification attestations, publishing authority, and recovery state remain separated across the documented stages.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Preserve credential isolation
rules.statement: Project code and preparation gates do not receive model, state, or publishing credentials; each stage receives only its documented credential and sanitized environment.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Respect configuration ownership
rules.statement: `touchstone.toml` is project-owned, `.touchstone/generated.toml` is machine-owned, unknown keys fail closed, and generated configuration changes use the supported migration or profile commands.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Keep executable validation explicit
rules.statement: New validation commands start disabled, require reviewed capabilities and preparation, and never become passing evidence when unsupported or inconclusive.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Run package quality gates
rules.statement: Use the uv-managed development environment and run pytest, Ruff, packaging, and repository-specific integration checks applicable to the change.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.
